label: copy-phase input token i (fed-back i, from the 2nd copied token on)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, at the step where the fed-back input is the letter i (that is, the model just output i and is now outputting the token after it). It is token-specific: other copy-phase inputs essentially never activate it, and it never fires on i during the original phase or on the delimiter. Rate on copy-phase i inputs is about 98% for recall_idx >= 2. When i is the first original token and is fed back at step L+1 (recall_idx 1), the feature is active only weakly (about 0.01-0.08 of max) and only some of the time; this is the only notable miss and carries 0.2% of the mass. Magnitude is high and fairly uniform (median 5.1 of max 6.9). The strongest activations come on the later i of a doubled i near the end of the sequence. The lowest quartile includes i at recall_idx 1-2 early in the copy (around 0.46-0.54 of max). Magnitude is not modulated by out_tok, prev_tok, or L beyond these position effects.

issues: Minor overclaim in explanation: 'strongest activations come on the later i of a doubled i near the end' is only weakly supported. Doubled-i with to_go<=1 makes up just 1.2% of the top activation quartile, against 0.45% of the bottom quartile. The main magnitude trend is a gradual rise with recall_idx: recall_idx>=6 i's cover 1%, 24%, 27% and 34% of quartiles Q1 to Q4.

Scattered tiny precursor activations (0.01-0.06 of max) on the copy-phase input just before an upcoming i, e.g. '[v:0.06] *[i:0.85]*'. There are 166 dev steps of this kind and they carry 0.0% of the mass. This is noise, not systematic.

Verified claims: zero activity in the original and delimiter phases. Precision on test is 1.0 with 0 false positives. Copy-phase non-i inputs have precision 6e-5 and mass 6e-5. The recall_idx==1 i case fires 18% of the time and carries 0.19% of the mass. recall_idx==2 i's sit mostly in the bottom quartile (79% coverage of Q1). The simpler predicate without the recall_idx condition scores F1 0.918 on test, as the other agent reported. Test F1 for the chosen predicate is 0.979 with mass recall 0.998.
